critical_code_review_comments: server.py ~1807 lines — should be split into auth/admin/tasks/wallet/referrals modules; not blocking.

watch_cycle_started_at and watch_cycle_used are NOT set in get_current_user setdefault block. They are exposed correctly because /auth/me returns the raw user dict which Pydantic model UserPublic defaults to None/0 — verified via curl on a brand-new device user (returns None, 0). Still, adding explicit setdefault('watch_cycle_started_at', None)/setdefault('watch_cycle_used', 0) in get_current_user would make exposure explicit and survive future model changes.
